name: 15-Minute Expressive Journaling
title: Write for 15 minutes about what is weighing on you.
benefit: A clearer head when something is weighing on you.
subtitle: Stress Release
rationale: Writing a live stressor down externalizes it, which stops it from occupying working memory during work.

evidence.summary: Meta-analysis of experimental disclosure studies shows small but reliable psychological and physical health benefits.

indications: One problem loops during work blocks and at lights-out.
A hard decision or conflict is consuming background attention.
Sleep onset is delayed by rumination.
